text:
marta: Hey — saw a subtle position drift on the new 13B-int8 build after ~7k tokens, trying to sanity-check if it's RoPE scaling or a cache alignment issue.
sam: ugh that's the one we've been worried about. quick repro?
marta: minimal repro: run long-chat with --quant=int8 --seq=8192 and compare logits against fp16 baseline. command: `tox -e smoke -- python tests/long_repro.py --model candidate-13b --quant int8 --seq 8192`
jin: can you paste the diff you saw? numbers or a short snippet is enough.
marta: pasted minimal snippet below: `token=7421: fp16_prob=0.0215 int8_prob=0.0179 delta=-16.7%` then at 7456 delta jumps to -48% and generation starts diverging.
lyn: interesting. does the divergence coincide with a shard boundary or a KV-rotation?
marta: I checked: no shard swap at that time. stack shows steady KV length. suspect positional interpolation when rotary wraps around.
sam: did you try disabling prefix caching or forcing cache flush on every token?
marta: yes: `--cache-mode=none` removes the big jump but latency gets terrible and smaller drifts still remain. so cache interaction exacerbates but isn't sole cause.
jin: could be small fp rounding accumulation from int8 matmul lowering. any pattern across seeds?
marta: ran 3 seeds: all show jump between 7420-7480 window. consistent.
lyn: assign a quick bisect: compare model weights quantized with per-channel vs per-tensor and check rotary scaling math in kernel. I'll start a run.
dev-bot: queued job 45218 -> /jobs/45218 (config: candidate-13b int8-perchannel flush-cache=true seq=8192) :gear:
marta: thanks. also logging idea — record `rotary_phase*` stats per layer at runtime, export as csv. helps see where phase resets deviate.
sam: good plan. also add a run with rotary alpha doubled (`--rotary-alpha=2.0`) to see sensitivity.
jin: if per-channel fixes it, that's a hint to quant calibration error. if not, we should instrument KV-indexing offsets around wrap points.
lyn: started a lightweight profiler on layer 10 where the phase drift looks largest. will upload traces.
marta: attaching quick trace excerpt: `L10 phase_accum 0.987 -> 1.002 -> -0.998` (wrap at token 7452)
sam: that wrap looks like a sign flip at 1.0 boundary — could be a modulo handling bug when converting float->int during quant math.
jin: stepping through kernel: `rotary_mul` uses integer index cast at one point, I recall a past fix for negative modulo. reopening that patch.
lyn: trace upload: https://internal-artifacts/reports/45218/trace_l10.csv
marta: next steps: 1) per-channel quant run (in flight), 2) run with cache disabled (done), 3) instrument kernel internals + double alpha test. I'll mark this as P2 for now but we should prevent rollout to Dedicated until root cause known.
sam: agree. put a short note in the release checklist: block candidate-13b-int8 for Dedicated-tier until this is resolved. :no_entry:
marta: noted. pinging @jin and @lyn for updates.
jin: will try reproducer locally and open a tiny PR with assert for modulo invariants.
lyn: will correlate traces with perf counters and KV index snapshots.
marta: thanks team, keeping thread here. will update with job 45218 results.
dev-bot: job 45218 completed: status=partial (logs at https://internal-artifacts/jobs/45218/logs)
